cases.prompt: Write a behave feature and steps for searching our site, using Selenium on local Chrome.
expectations: Creates the browser in before_scenario (or before_all) and quits it in after_scenario.
Steps use context to share the driver.
Uses explicit waits rather than sleeps.

cases.prompt: I want to run the same login scenario for three different users in behave.
expectations: Writes a Scenario Outline with an Examples table of three users.
Step definitions take parameters from the placeholders.
Shows the expected outcome per row.
